title: Tart Zucchini Fritters with Lightly Sweetened German Sauce
description: Indulge in crispy zucchini fritters served with a lightly sweetened German-inspired sauce for a delightful meal.
instructions: Slice the zucchinis into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
In a large bowl, whisk together the vegan yogurt, lemon juice, German mustard, garlic, and olive oil.
Add the sliced zucchinis to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Roll out the tart pastry crust to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a few zucchini slices in the center of each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry over the zucchini to form a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the fritters with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the fritters for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Serve the fritters hot with the warm sauce for dipping.
